metadata.projection: Local equirectangular; centimetres; X=east, Y=south, Z=flat
metadata.geometry: Actual OSM road polylines clipped to radius; roads are flattened, not surveyed elevation
metadata.widths: OSM width when tagged, otherwise estimates from lanes or road class
metadata.observed_features: features contains only explicit OSM tags; their presence today is unverified
metadata.condition_coverage: Incomplete community mapping; missing tags never establish smoothness, safety or absence of hazards
metadata.rendering_note: The runtime currently reads road geometry and railway crossings. Additional tags/features are retained for future rendering and do not imply they are all simulated.
